text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent victory!
And toward the packed stadium of fans—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Raising a hand is Neo Universe!
It's Neo Universe!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe is just a little bit
'excited.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "A hard-fought victory. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Why do you have your arms raised?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's "transmitting".
Sending "joy"... beyond the star system.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Keeping her raised hand just as it was,
Neo Universe walked all the way back to the underground tunnel.
choice_data_list: Congratulations, but it's about time to...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Put it back?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Even by force?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative.
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*bonk* ☆)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That hand struck me squarely on the head.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry. Neo Universe became
a 'youthful indiscretion,' didn't she...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It didn't really hurt. But my joy had certainly been transmitted loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And once they returned to the waiting room...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent run,
Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That Trainer came over
to praise her great run.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text: My girl wasn't a match for you... But I think she gave it everything she had.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Watching your race today... made me think.
I knew it...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that it was good that I chose a different path...
made me feel a little saved...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Trainer gave a slight shrug...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"If I had been her Trainer,
I wouldn't have been able to draw out
Neo Universe's power to this extent."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how she ran today, I finally felt like
everything we did was the right choice.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure there's someone out there who connects with you even better...
Because... I was able to see that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There must have been deep affection, worries, and anguish.
Even so, they chose to honor their prior commitment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This person isn't a bad person.
They are likely a Trainer capable of making the right decisions,
best suited for anyone."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This "FELT" is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this "person" is "SETO" too...
It's "SETO".

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text: Huh, "SETO"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes, "SETO."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like Oguri Cap,
she holds a precious fragment...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Which means, in one way or another, our relationship might continue from here on out."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Trainer.
I don't really get it, but...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, who understands Neo Universe's words,
really is the best partner."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the first hurdle of the Classic Triple Crown was cleared.
The next goal is the Japanese Derby, but—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, our next target race is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—“Precipitation.”
It's rain...
choice_data_list: Rain...? Is the weather taking a turn for the worse?
Rain...? Is the weather taking a turn for the worse?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Weather forecasting... I wonder if one could
predict it to some extent through sea temperatures and the like.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yet, that rain...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Negative. It's not just rain.
It is very—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Very... "VOXT".
That rain is not "me"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Interfering" with the Trainer.
Inviting "severance."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Shutting out our bond...
The bulkhead... of the contract.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They were quite difficult words to decipher.
Interference... Contract bulkhead...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There shouldn't be any problem with my Trainer contract
with Neo Universe. So why...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Even so—come. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because "I want to run." For your sake.
And... together with "you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—You and 'You'.
A meaningless refrain of words.
And yet, it seems...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"According to Neo Universe's 'future prediction,'
the next Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)
is shaping up to be quite a tricky race."
